postStep10Changes: Calibration table headers were localized for correct display in both languages.
Two calibration headings were shortened to subject labels; final Chinese headings and corresponding English were rechecked.
truth: The confirmed Tianjin homepage and all five sibling notes were read in both languages.
Original lookup and main-loop C excerpts support the 16 values, decreasing ADC relation, interpolation, round-to-integer step, 999 clamp and separation of measurement from lookup input.
Worked values: target 1000 -> 209.090909 -> 209; PWM 550 -> predicted ADC 700.5; inverse slopes 0.142857 and 1.672241; 100 pF and 4.7 kohm -> 398.231 ns; hypothetical address 0x3C -> write byte 0x78.
Additional calibration measurements, ambient-light change to ADC 900, proportional correction and same-pin I2C comparison are present calculations or proposed work, not historical tests.
OLED model, historical SCL/SDA pin pair, bus rate, waveforms and exact original fault are not invented. ST F1 HAL source is current reading, not a claim that the internship used HAL.
voiceAndBilingual: pass; Chinese composed first, with direct calculations and circuit questions. English retains the same explanations, proposed checks and endings using natural independent sentence forms. No old-draft information-retention gate or evidence-inventory narration was added.
crossPage: New notes develop interpolation coverage and I2C signaling; the homepage retains the internship progression. Both drafts keep short opening context and avoid reproducing whole build/bring-up scenes. The five older notes remain suspended as sources.
scope: Local candidate drafts, preview packets, the Chinese sentence-gate reference and handoff records change. Production content, application source and public assets remain unchanged; About is parked separately.

views.title: 光照标定与查表控制
views.ending: 这个修正还要等新的采样结果到来再计算，并结合采样间隔和 LED、传感器的响应选择系数，最后把输出限制在允许范围内。环境光足够强时，即使 LED 已经关闭，读数也可能达不到目标，继续减小指令便没有作用。查表能帮我快速给出一个起始值，反馈负责根据当前读数调整；而灯能调多亮、能暗到什么程度，最终还是由这套实物决定。

views.title: I²C 通信与 OLED 调试
views.ending: 屏幕不亮时，可以沿着供电、总线电平、地址应答和显示数据逐段检查。每多看清一步，下一次测量就能更有针对性。对我来说，软件 I²C 的学习价值也在这里：把释放引脚、等待时钟和读取应答写清楚以后，再去读硬件外设的状态位，就更容易理解程序正在等什么。
